title: Your Fleet, Your Way
description: See how ships, ownership, customization, rentals, and fleet identity become one of the strongest premium hooks in Star Atlas.
heroTitle: In Star Atlas, your fleet is identity, leverage, and access.
heroSummary: Ships are not just a catalog. They are how players express taste, capability, status, and economic intent. This page now presents fleet ownership as a premium system instead of a scattered list of features.
utilityLine: The job of this page is to make fleet ownership feel aspirational and understandable in the same glance.

heroPanel.title: People engage when the product makes ambition tangible.
heroPanel.body: Fleet ownership is one of the strongest emotional and strategic hooks in Star Atlas. The redesign gives it the editorial weight it deserves.
bullets: Connected to economy, travel, and status

cards.title: Ships define capability
cards.body: What you can reach, haul, defend, or command is shaped by the fleet you assemble.

cards.title: Ships communicate identity
cards.body: The fleet becomes a visible statement about taste, commitment, and intent.

cards.title: Rentals widen participation
cards.body: Players can test roles, scale faster, or monetize idle assets without hard binary ownership barriers.

cards.title: Composition changes outcomes
cards.body: Fleet building is a decision surface, not just a collection hobby.

sections.heading: This template turns a complex ownership story into a premium sales moment.
body: Instead of burying the appeal of ships under scattered utility text, the redesign makes the emotional pitch and the practical value legible at the same time.
That balance matters because the best conversion moments on a product like this are aspirational, not merely informational.
sections.asideTitle: The visitor should picture themselves inside the system.
sections.asideBody: A premium page helps people imagine their role in the product rather than just read about it.

sections.heading: What the page answers clearly now.

items.question: Is ownership required to engage with Star Atlas?
items.answer: No. The redesign makes rentals and browser entry points more visible so the path into the ecosystem feels less gated.

items.question: Why emphasize identity so much here?
items.answer: Because premium products convert when they connect utility to aspiration. The fleet system does both.

finalCta.title: Turn fleet interest into real engagement.
finalCta.text: Browse the marketplace, explore browser systems, or continue into the strategic command layer.
